entities.name: Kaima
entities.description: A protective kami of the plane Kamigawa, shaped like a massive boar with bear's claws, who lives at the roots of Boseiju.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: The tree at whose roots Kaima lives.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: A group Kaima suspects of destroying the balance of nature with technology.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Defenders of the forest whom Kaima volunteered to help.

entities.name: Chishiro
entities.description: An orochi samurai whose sword Kaima channeled his magic into.

entities.name: Tatsunari
entities.description: A toad-rider who led the Futurists in trapping Chishiro.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A city whose Far Corner neighborhood has a shrine Kaima found.

entities.name: Mukotai
entities.description: A group whose scout Kaima killed.

entities.name: Reckoner gang
entities.description: The gang against which Kaima's killing began a war.

events.summary: Kaima channeled his magic into Chishiro's sword and the pair became a fearsome force.
events.quote: Kaima channeled his magic into the sword of an orochi samurai named Chishiro

events.summary: Led by Tatsunari the Futurists trapped Chishiro, broke his sword and killed his companions; Chishiro shattered his bond with Kaima.
events.quote: they trapped Chishiro, broke his sword, and killed his companions

events.summary: Enraged, Kaima began a rampage and came to hate humans.
events.quote: Kaima was enraged, and driven from Chishiro began a rampage.

events.summary: Kaima killed a Mukotai scout at Towashi, beginning a war with the Reckoner gang.
events.quote: Kaima killed the scout, beginning a war with the Reckoner gang.

events.summary: Chishiro, hired by the village elders, chased off the Mukotai and reforged his bond with Kaima and his blade.
events.quote: he was able to reforge the bond with his kami and his blade along with it

relations.quote: Their bond was represented in the blade the samurai carried.
he is staunchly suspicious of technology and the Saiba Futurists destroying the peace and balance of nature

relations.note: Led the Futurists' tactic against Chishiro.
